title: Continuation and missing-work discipline
summary: The exact qualified dev8 runtime source is now published. Continue by preserving that provenance, reconciling newer Wire3D collector work, and freshly qualifying current producers/live carriage. Do not grow a competing transport, logging system, topology authority or incident engine.
